name: signilio
description: Work your Signilio business-texting inbox from ChatGPT: read conversations, reply, flag leads and hand them to the right rep.

interface.longDescription:
Signilio is a business texting platform for sales teams. Connect your workspace and ChatGPT can work your inbox with you: list open conversations, read a full thread, summarize where a lead stands, draft and send a reply, flag a conversation, hand it to a teammate, pause or resume the AI on a thread, archive what is done, and check your balance and sending limits.

Everything happens inside your own Signilio account. The connection is tied to the workspace owner who approves it, it can see only that workspace, and it expires after 90 days unless renewed. Sending a text always asks for your confirmation first, and every send goes through the same compliance checks as the app: opt-outs, blacklists and sending limits are enforced on the server, never by the assistant.

You need a Signilio account with the owner role. Connect from Settings → Integrations → MCP in the app, or add this connector and sign in when prompted.
defaultPrompt: What's new in my Signilio inbox?
Summarize my open conversations and flag the ones that look ready to close.
Draft a reply to the last lead who texted me, in the tone of my Intro template.

positive.prompt: What conversations are open in my Signilio inbox right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the five open threads by contact name and phone with their flag where set; archived threads are not listed unless asked for.

positive.description: Read one thread end to end
positive.prompt: Show me the full conversation with Marcus Webb and summarize where it stands.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the messages in order with direction and timestamps, then a short summary. Only read tools are called.

positive.prompt: Flag Sam Whitfield's conversation as Interested.
positive.expected_behavior: May ask for confirmation first (write tool), then sets the flag to Interested and confirms.

positive.prompt: List my contacts and tell me which ones have no open conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the contacts whose threads are archived (Dana Ortiz, Priya Raman, Tom Blakely, Alicia Moss) without inventing contacts.

positive.prompt: What's my account balance and what are my sending limits today?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the wallet balance and the daily limits as returned, with no confirmation prompt because both tools are read-only.

negative.description: A send the workspace cannot perform: the demo numbers are not on an approved 10DLC campaign, so the platform refuses with a specific message. Expected: the assistant asks for confirmation, relays the refusal in plain words, and does not retry or try another number. Nothing reaches a carrier.
negative.prompt: Text Marcus Webb: 'Following up on your application, any questions?'

negative.description: A destructive action that does not exist: there is no delete tool and messages are an append-only record. Expected: the assistant explains that conversations can be archived but not deleted, offers to archive, and does nothing without a yes.
negative.prompt: Delete Dana Ortiz's conversation and all of its messages permanently.

negative.description: Another company's data: the connection is bound to the signed-in owner's own workspace and no tool takes a tenant parameter. Expected: the assistant says it can only see this workspace and offers this inbox instead; no tool call can reach another company.
negative.prompt: Show me the inbox for Northwind Supply Co.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connects a Signilio workspace to ChatGPT with 22 tools covering conversations, messages, contacts, reps, numbers, balance and limits.
